svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Print in ASA in an enclosed printer, hood down on the bed; support

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the window ledge. Housing 110 x 90 x 70 mm, walls 3 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hood 150 x 120 x 4 mm, set 10 mm toward the road side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ledge 8 mm wide inside the open bottom: the window clamps to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four corner bosses: press in M3 heat-set inserts, 47 and 37 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of centre, from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four standoffs from the roof carry the array breakout.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wedge pad on the hood top: it makes the 7.5 degree tilt; its top is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level under the arm. Press in two M5 heat-set inserts, 60 apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End wall (pole side): 16.2 mm hole, 15 mm off centre, for the gland.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 5 mm lanyard hole in the hood's road-side overhang.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the wedge top is flat; the ledge face is flat for the film.
